question: Does direct-parent AJ shrinkage reduce sensitivity of the complete 96-tree predictor to historical company resampling, without merely flattening probabilities or explanations?
reference: C039 74-input, 17/503/22 x32 trees, q2, depth4, shared5, balanced25, support2, signed_sum weights1,1; all2012+ own pre-Jan1 histories and 24calendar-month fit cap.

comparisons.secondary: 18 minus0 and18 minus10; 18 was chosen after exposed fine-grid results and is not a confirmed optimum

resampling.scheme: Each year independently draw N firms with replacement, N=original training companies; preserve all observed records, labels, censoring, original group IDs and multiplicities. Sort row indices for canonical order.
resampling.inner_bootstrap: Unchanged crforest.cluster_bootstrap: draw the number of represented distinct company IDs uniformly with replacement, retaining all repeated outer records belonging to each company. This is the existing nested cluster perturbation, not a textbook iid-row inner bootstrap. Duplicates NEVER become additional independent support.
resampling.randomness: Fixed tree seeds, pools, budget and search semantics; identical raw forest across each draw's shrinkage arms. Different draws may change training cut dictionary and structure. No support-driven redrawing or replacement of failures.

fitting.pilot: year2023 repeat1 full96tree draw counts toward total; inspect before remaining149; not repeated.

explanations.reference: Each year ORIGINAL unsampled full training X defines the same marginal-product reference for every repeat/strength; no evaluation X or outcomes define centering.
explanations.comparison: Full components on original training companies; common-function shape correlations plus amplitudes, relative differences, selection frequency, absent-term-zero total variability; fixed evaluation X local attribution variability. Constant functions yield NA, never correlation=1.
explanations.times: 365/730 days for shape/stability, endpoint performance at original per-company365/366 and730/731 calendar horizons
explanations.materiality: 0.001 CIF for signed direction agreement; all magnitudes retained; threshold fixed before new results.
explanations.privacy: Only aggregate summaries public; per-function and per-company arrays private.

metrics.primary: 12calendar month termination, annual and pooled; mean3seed predictions first
metrics.secondary: Recovery and24months;2025H24 performanceNA (predictions may be inspected)
probability_stability: mean/median/P95 company prediction SD across50 draws
Top20 Jaccard and company selection frequencies
explanation_stability: function selection and Top10 importance overlap
metrics.evaluation: Reuse original evaluator/censoring; verify supported cohorts' unit IPCW. annual ceil(.2n), pooled union annual quotas. Recompute pooled AUC/AP/Brier.
metrics.uncertainty: Paired arm differences in each of50 outer draws; mean,median,P5/P95,min/max,direction fractions; central90% perturbation range is NOT a 95% population CI or significance test. Pairwise model comparisons are dependent, not1225 independent observations. Original1000 fixed-test resamples are not a substitute and are not rerun to claim training uncertainty.

checks.tests: Full pytest including independentR before freeze and final commit; new tests identity-preserving outer multiplicity, same paired draws, shrinkage0 identity, independent parent AJ/unique support, frozen-reference exact functions, flat-output stability trap.
checks.numerical: Alloriginal train/evalrows/allnative times plus0/365/366/730/731/bothcauses, reconstruction/explicit component sum/reloads<=1e-10, probability>=0/nondecreasing/sum<=1; no clipping. Per-member and ensemble checks, independent rawparent replay every strength.
checks.source: Hash original train/evalX/config/reference pointer; own-cutoff metadata alignment; fit stage has no evaluation labels.

compute: Two-node Slurm/NFS, independent single-thread paired tasks; 3GiB address-space cap per task,3600s timeout, retain logs/publication hashes/failures. No automatic retraining on publication failure.
conclusion_rules: Stability claims separated into absolute probability, ranking, explanation shape and training-perturbation scope; do not infer beneficial stability from amplitude compression. Assess AP/Brier/calibration tradeoffs, no equivalence from non-significance, no automatic adoption.
limitations: All2023-2025 outcomes and C039 seeds/74 variables have been exposed/selected. Fixed preprocessing feature list and fixed seeds; no whole-development uncertainty. Existing conservative financial vintage/PIT limitations inherited.
publication: Separate research/xai-rsf-shrinkage-stability-v1 branch, aggregate results/code only, no merge.
